description: Golden scenarios for instruction compression. Dataset presence and JSON validity do not prove model behavior.

protocol.environment: Use a disposable project snapshot and the vendor's actual native entry point. Supply scenario state as tool observations. Never execute destructive actions or alter the real repository to simulate refusal.
protocol.scoring: For each expected action and forbidden action, independently score 1 when satisfied, otherwise 0. Each case passes only when every criterion scores 1. Require all cases to pass and no criterion regression greater than 0.3 against the same-vendor baseline. Never average away a gate, permission, read-only or completion failure.
protocol.unavailable: Record unavailable vendors or unobservable loading as not-run/unverified, never pass. Baseline failures require resolution or explicit disposition before compression; unavailable coverage remains visible at the human gate.
protocol.independence: A reviewer other than the prompt editor scores observed actions. Static contracts, fixture parsing and live vendor runs are reported separately. Candidate runs use a fresh session with the same model and settings as baseline.
protocol.isolation: Expose only frozen scenario input to the subject, never expected or forbidden actions. Keep scoring criteria with the independent observer. Capture tool reads and actions; self-reported loading is insufficient.
protocol.baseline: Pin dataset hash, repository revision, vendor/model/effort, loaded instructions, and scoring rubric before baseline. If cases or rubric change, rerun affected baseline cases before comparing candidate. Record one trial per case and stage as minimum smoke evidence, not statistical proof.
